Market today: The market's buzzing with strong demand for chips and AI-driven shipments, especially from China. However, higher bond yields and options-driven volatility in memory stocks could create headwinds for your tech-heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-48%) and SPAL (-57.73%) are flashing red. Both are leveraged ETFs, have suffered massive drawdowns, and their listed stops are well above current prices, indicating they were breached. Margin amplifies these drops, so these need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields for their impact on growth stocks. Also, monitor any further news on chip demand and supply dynamics.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged, deeply underwater positions to protect your capital.
plays: Your -48% SOXL position has breached its stop. Consider exiting or significantly trimming to cut losses on this leveraged, decaying ETF.
Your SPAL position is down -57.73% and its stop was breached. This leveraged ETF needs immediate attention; consider exiting to prevent further capital erosion.
Chip demand is strong. Consider a new buy on TSM at entry 417.78-417.36, stop 415.59, supported by scanner setup and positive chip news.
